videos.title: JCESR Scientific Sprints — Better Polymers for Better Batteries
videos.summary: JCESR scientific sprint feature on polymer redoxmer chemistry for next-generation batteries. Lu Zhang appears as one of the featured presenters explaining the team's flow-battery work.

items.title: An integrated high-throughput robotic platform and active learning approach for accelerated discovery of optimal electrolyte formulations
items.summary: Robotic chemistry + ML for electrolyte discovery. Co-authored work demonstrating an automated workflow that screened a 2000+ solvent library and identified solvents with >6.20 M solubility for 2,1,3-benzothiadiazole, while testing fewer than 10% of candidates.

items.title: AI used to optimize several flow battery properties simultaneously
items.summary: Coverage of the JCESR / Argonne quantum-chemistry-guided multiobjective Bayesian optimization study — searching a million-molecule chemical space for optimal flow battery materials.
